issues.explanation: The section states that approval was attributed to the 744th session of the National IT Standards Committee dated 1403/05/23. None of the supplied evidence items — including I23682-id, O23682-006 (پیش‌گفتار), or any other item — contains a committee session number or a date for that session. The preface evidence item (O23682-006) provides only the heading 'پیش‌گفتار'; no content from it is transcribed that would support this specific claim.
issues.quote: تصویب به هفتصد و چهل و چهارمین اجلاسیهٔ کمیتهٔ ملی استاندارد فناوری اطلاعات مورخ ۱۴۰۳/۰۵/۲۳ نسبت داده شده
issues.suggested_fix: حذف کامل این جمله تا زمانی که متن پیش‌گفتار چاپ‌شده (O23682-006) در مجموعهٔ شواهد گنجانده شود و شمارهٔ اجلاسیه و تاریخ را تأیید کند.

issues.explanation: The section describes INSO 23733:1403 as 'معادل یکسان ISO/IEC 23894:2023'. Evidence item I23682-rel1 says only 'bibliography note says it was developed using ISO/IEC 23894:2023'. The phrase 'developed using' is the standard INSO bibliographic formula that covers IDT, MOD, and NEQ adoptions alike; no evidence item confirms the equivalence type is specifically 'معادل یکسان' (IDT).
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with a phrasing faithful to the evidence: «INSO 23733:1403 (تهیه‌شده بر اساس ISO/IEC 23894:2023)». If the equivalence type is confirmed from the cover of that standard, cite it explicitly.
